title: Web: strength trend
description: Whether lifting is improving overall over the `training.strength_trend_days` (28) days ending on the day (fa_coach.strength_trend). For each counting lift with at least 2 sessions in the window (after its latest baseline reset, if any), each session's heaviest working set as estimated 1RM (effective load for bodyweight lifts); per ISO week, the lift's best value as % change from its first session in the window. A week's value is the mean over the lifts trained up to that week, each carrying its last value forward (null before any). Shown on Home's Gym block (small) and at the top of the Training tab (larger).

weeks.description: The ISO weeks the window touches, oldest first.

change_pct.description: The last week's value: the change over the window, 1 decimal. Null without a lift that qualifies.

direction.description: rising above +training.e1rm_same_band_pct, falling below its negative, flat within; null with change_pct null.

lifts.description: Lifts that count toward the trend.
